design_philosophy: A gritty, high-end music magazine aesthetic. Pure deep blacks, stark white typography, and vibrant signal red for accents. No soft gradients, no purple/teal. Use sharp contrasts and structural grids to build tension. The design should evoke the feeling of a live concert backstage or a premium music studio.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-16) for marketing pages to let images breathe. Dense data bento grids for the dashboard and admin panel.

grid_modes.marketing_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Create asymmetry by making hero span 8 cols and secondary items 4 cols.
grid_modes.dashboard_control_room: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.

surface_strategies.marketing_cards: Flat background (bg-card), 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. On hover, subtle red border glow (border-primary/50) and slight lift (-translate-y-1).
surface_strategies.dashboard_widgets: Neumorphic clay & crisp variant: matching background, 1px border to ground it, high-contrast text.
surface_strategies.header_nav: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-background/60 border-b border-white/10. Sticky at top with z-50.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: Solid Red (bg-primary) with sharp edges (rounded-none or sm), text-white, hover:brightness-110. Secondary: Transparent with 1px white border, hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors.
surface_strategies.image_overlays: Max overlay opacity bg-black/50. Prefer gradient overlays to maintain image visibility.

components_usage.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium, sharp duotone look.
components_usage.video_player: Custom stylized wrapper for YouTube embeds. Pure black background, 1px subtle border, red playback progress bar if possible.
components_usage.tables: Shadcn tables but with custom spacing. Dark rows, red active states for the admin panel student management.
components_usage.forms_inputs: Shadcn inputs heavily customized: dark background, white text, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary. No generic blue rings.

motion_animations.hover_states: Micro-interactions: interactive elements must clearly show hover (color shift, border highlight). Transition all 0.2s ease.
motion_animations.page_transitions: Optional Framer Motion fade-in and slide-up (y: 20) for main content blocks to feel cinematic.

media_urls.description: Close-up of an electric guitar fretboard in dark lighting. Perfect for landing page hero.
Moody shot of playing acoustic guitar. Use for 'Guitar Class' course highlights.
Hands playing piano in dark setting. Use for 'Keyboard coming soon' section.
Gritty portrait of a musician. Use for Instructor Profile section or testimonials.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='course-enroll-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi fonts via Fontshare CDN in public/index.html: <link href='https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@900,800,700,500,400&f[]=satoshi@900,700,500,400&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>
Update tailwind.config.js with the provided color palette (HSL values) and font families.
Set dark mode as the default. Ensure the body uses the dark background and foreground colors.
Build the Landing Page with massive, asymmetrical, high-impact sections. Avoid the 'default SaaS' look.
Build the Dashboard using a dense, grid-based layout. Keep it highly functional with strict alignments.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react. Do not use generic icons.
For the red accent (primary color), use it strategically for CTAs, active states, and to break the grid tension. DO NOT overuse it.
